MainApp._comment: Match the main SculptFlow app. PublicBaseUrl = its public HTTPS origin (no trailing slash), used to build Infobip webhook URLs. WhatsAppProvider = its WhatsApp:Provider value (meta | infobip), shown for reference. Billing pages call the main app's platform-admin API: ApiBaseUrl = where to call it (blank = PublicBaseUrl); PlatformAdminApiKey is a SECRET equal to the main app's PlatformAdmin:ApiKey — set it via the MainApp__PlatformAdminApiKey env var or user-secrets, never here.
